svg.text: The trigger input briefly goes low. The timer then charges its timing
capacitor until the threshold ends the output pulse.
Measure the output pulse width and compare it with 1.1 × R × C. Double
R, rerun and explain the change.
Use a compatible timer model, trigger once and measure pulse duration.

Open the Simulation tab and press Run. Select a source or component to
see its values. Read the labelled signals, then change one quantity at a
time. Equal net labels identify connected points.
What changed, and why? Use your readings as evidence.
